# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple unversioned app TFM support and fixes a WinUI projection DLL failure.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported** — The v4 support for building against the Apple 26.0 SDK with unversioned app target framework monikers has been backported to the 3.119.x line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 consumers fixed** — Apps targeting .NET 9 with WinUI no longer fail to locate the Projection DLL at runtime. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
